india.one_line: Karnataka leads India's AI hubs, Sarvam AI launches inference hosting, and startups secure new funding.

themes.title: Karnataka hosts 1,088 GCCs and AI professionals
themes.text: A new Zinnov-KDEM report released at the Bengaluru Tech Summit 2026 shows Karnataka hosts 1,088 global capability centres and 111,000 AI/ML professionals.

stories.headline: Karnataka hosts 1,088 GCCs and 111,000 AI/ML professionals, new report finds

themes.title: Sarvam AI token factory sparks debate
themes.text: Sarvam AI launched its Token Factory inference platform on Indian GPUs using six Chinese open-weight models, drawing scrutiny over its government GPU subsidy.

stories.headline: Sarvam AI’s Token Factory hosts mostly Chinese models on Indian GPUs, sparking sovereign AI debate

themes.title: Startups secure funding for AI expansion
themes.text: Disseqt AI raised $8 million to expand its governance platform and increase hiring in India, while SatSure secured ₹60 crore for its geospatial AI model.

stories.headline: Disseqt AI raises $8 million to expand enterprise AI governance platform
SatSure raises ₹60 Cr from Antariksh VC fund in Series B round
